name: waymesh-mobility
description: Decentralized peer-to-peer ride sharing, safe carpooling, and crowdshipping on the Waymesh open protocol.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate decentralized ride sharing, safe carpooling, and crowdshipping logistics on the Waymesh open protocol with direct private peer-to-peer (cash, UPI, or mutual agreement) settlement. Strictly enforces same-gender carpooling (males with males, females with females).
defaultPrompt: I need safe carpooling from CET to KCVL today at 5:00 PM.
Publish a commuter ride from Campus North Gate to City Central Railway Station.
